items.headline: Bruno Fernandes named Player of the Month for August
items.summary: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes wins Player of the Month award after outstanding end to August, including hat-trick against Ipswich.

items.headline: Bryan Mbeumo wins Goal of the Month for August
items.summary: Manchester United midfielder Bryan Mbeumo awarded Goal of the Month for August after impressive scoring contribution.

items.headline: Mason Mount returns to full training ahead of Everton fixture
items.summary: Michael Carrick confirms Mason Mount back in full training after recent absence, available for selection against Everton.

items.headline: Louie Bradbury departs Manchester United for Stoke City
items.summary: Academy striker Louie Bradbury seals move away from Manchester United to join Stoke City.

items.headline: Manchester United to revive Louis Page transfer talks
items.summary: Manchester United could reopen discussions for Leicester midfielder Louis Page after deadline-day collapse over £15m valuation.
